title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.28649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flas

translated_title: S-Mind：将多视图几何内化以实现空间智能
translated_abstract: 空间智能，即从视觉观察中对三维空间进行推理的能力，随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）走向物理世界而变得至关重要。除了感知每个视图之外，空间智能还依赖于人类认知的两个基石：将多个视图融合为一个连贯的三维场景，以及在推理过程中将该场景在心理上变换到新的视角。然而，我们的空间探针测试显示，MLLM在很大程度上缺乏这两种能力，即使经过空间微调也是如此。因此，我们提出了S-Mind，它通过一组紧凑的空间token将多视图几何内化到MLLM中。它监督这些token以保存融合后的三维场景，并重新发射这些token，以便从推理所采用的每个视角重新表达该场景。在四个空间基准测试中，S-Mind使其Qwen3.5骨干模型的性能提升高达22.26分，并超越了GPT-6-Astra（+0.45）、Kimi-K3.1-Pro（+1.97）和GLM-5.3-Flash等前沿通用模型。
tldr: S-Mind通过一组紧凑的空间token将多视图几何内化到多模态大语言模型中，使其能够将多视图融合为连贯的3D场景并在推理中灵活变换视角，在四个空间基准上大幅超越前沿通用模型。
en_tdlr: S-Mind internalizes multi-view geometry into MLLMs through a compact set of spatial tokens, enabling them to fuse multiple views into a coherent 3D scene and mentally transform it to new viewpoints during reasoning, outperforming frontier general models across four spatial benchmarks.
